name: Arlen Ness Bagger-Tail Fiberglass Rear Fender Kit for 2002-2008 Harley Davidson, Black
description: Arlen Ness Bagger-Tail Fiberglass Rear Fender Kit for 2002-2008 Harley Davidson FLT Models Bagger fender kits from Arlen Ness are a direct replacement for the factory fender on 2002-2008 FLT models. Pre-drilled composite fenders give your bike a clean unique look while filling in the gap between the fender and saddlebags. Fenders can be used with either a stock width rear tire or up to a 200mm tire with Arlen Ness wide tire conversion kit for FLTs. Supplied with a Ness/RWD LED license/taillight assembly with turn signals that mount in the recessed area of the fenders. Light assembly plugs into the factory harness for simple installation. Hidden steel fender support brackets and flexible hidden antenna are included for a clean installation. Arlen Ness recommends using the Bagger fender kit with either their saddlebag extensions or Arlens Big Bags. Bagger-Tail fender design has cut-outs for dual exhaust setup and comes in a primed finish.
